title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Brock Bowers (hamstring/calf) upgraded to full participant Thursday
items.desc: Brock Bowers (hamstring/calf) was upgraded to a full participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Bowers was limited on Wednesday due to a pair of minor injuries that he's managing, but he was upgraded to a full participant on Thursday and will be good to go for Week 7. He will continue to be a top-tier fantasy option at the position for as long as he remains healthy and on the field moving forward.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jalyx Hunt (knee/ankle) listed as limited Thursday
items.desc: Jalyx Hunt (knee/ankle) was listed as a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: The young edge rusher was sidelined last week due to injury, but he was able to practice on Thursday and seems to be trending the right way for Week 7. Philadelphia's defensive front would see a nice boost if he's able to play this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Tyler Steen (shoulder) limited participant Thursday
items.desc: Tyler Steen (shoulder) was a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Steen was limited for another practice session on Thursday, but he was able to play through his shoulder injury last week and projects to do the same again this week. His presence would be a big deal for a thin Eagles' offensive line on Monday night.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Dontayvion Wicks (ankle) sidelined at practice Thursday
items.desc: Dontayvion Wicks (ankle) was sidelined at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: The young wideout wasn't able to practice on Thursday, as he's managing an ankle issue of some kind right now. It could threaten his availability for Week 7, but only if he's not able to practice on Friday either.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Landon Dickerson (knee/pec) limited Thursday
items.desc: Landon Dickerson (knee/pec) was limited at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Dickerson still hasn't made his return for the Eagles and was limited for another practice on Thursday. It remains to be seen if he will play in Week 7, but if he does, that will offer a significant boost to a short-handed Eagles' offensive front.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: DeVonta Smith (hamstring) misses practice Thursday
items.desc: DeVonta Smith (hamstring) missed Philadelphia's practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Smith is still dealing with a lingering hamstring issue, but he played through it last week, so it seems his absence at practice was more of injury management on the part of the team. He should play on Monday night, but he may be a risky starter with QB Tanner McKee set to be the starter for the Eagles moving forward.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Saquon Barkley (hamstring) officially limited Thursday
items.desc: Saquon Barkley (hamstring) was officially a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Barkley was able to make his return to practice on Thursday. He was still a limited participant, but it's a good sign that he was able to participate at all and bodes well for his availability for Week 7. He will re-assume the RB1 job if he's active for Monday night's game against the Cowboys.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Dallas Goedert (knee) doesn't practice Thursday
items.desc: Dallas Goedert (knee) did not take part in Philadelphia's practice on Thursday.
items.impact: The Eagles let Goedert sit out of their first practice of the week on Thursday. It seems to be just for injury management purposes, but fantasy managers should continue to keep tabs on his status throughout the week to ensure that he will be available to play on Monday night. His fantasy value will be questionable this week even if he's healthy, however, with QB Tanner McKee set to be the starter for the Eagles moving forward.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Pat Surtain II (ankle) limited participant Thursday
items.desc: Pat Surtain II (ankle) was a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Surtain was limited for a second-straight practice on Thursday, which is no surprise considering that he has been dealing with this ankle issue for a while. We should know more about his availability for Week 7 after the team's final practice of the week on Friday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jonah Coleman (ankle) logs another full practice Thursday
items.desc: Jonah Coleman (ankle) logged another full practice session on Thursday.
items.impact: The rookie seems to be geared up to play in Week 7, as he has logged two-straight full practices to start the week. He isn't likely to be a strong fantasy option in his first few games, but he should be involved enough to hurt the fantasy value of RJ Harvey for the foreseeable future.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jaylen Waddle (chest) limited again Thursday
items.desc: Jaylen Waddle (chest) was limited at practice again on Thursday.
items.impact: Waddle was limited for a second-straight practice on Thursday. He's dealing with a chest issue right now, and it remains to be seen if it will leave him with an injury designation heading into the weekend. Courtland Sutton will see more work in the off-chance that Waddle is unable to play in Week 7.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Theo Johnson (neck) considered limited again Thursday
items.desc: Theo Johnson (neck) was considered a limited participant at practice again on Thursday.
items.impact: Johnson has been limited at both practices to start the week while he recovers from a neck issue. Not much should change from a fantasy standpoint even if he's ruled out for this week, however.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jevon Holland (concussion) returns to practice Thursday
items.desc: Jevon Holland (concussion) returned to practice and was a limited participant on Thursday.
items.impact: Holland suffered a concussion last week and is currently in the NFL's concussion protocols as a result, but he was back at practice and participating in a limited fashion on Thursday. He may be cleared in time to play in Week 7, which would be great news for New York's defense ahead of a matchup against the Texans.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Paulson Adebo (knee) logs limited practice Thursday
items.desc: Paulson Adebo (knee) logged a limited practice session on Thursday.
items.impact: The Giants recently opened Adebo's practice window, and he was able to log a limited practice session on Thursday. He seems to be a long-shot to play in Week 7, but we won't know for sure until later this week sometime.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Marcus Mbow (knee) listed as limited Thursday
items.desc: Marcus Mbow (knee) was listed as a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Mbow is dealing with a knee injury and could be sidelined in Week 7 because of it. That will be a problem if Jermaine Eluemunor (calf) is ruled out, as Mbow is the guy New York uses to compensate for his absence.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Charlie Jones (Achilles) limited again Thursday
items.desc: Charlie Jones (Achilles) was limited at practice again on Thursday.
items.impact: Jones was again limited on Thursday as he continues to deal with an Achilles issue of some kind. He is relegated to mostly a special teams role at this point in the season, however, so his status won't have much of an impact for fantasy purposes this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jermaine Eluemunor (calf) upgraded to limited Thursday
items.desc: Jermaine Eluemunor (calf) was upgraded to a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Eluemunor missed last week's game and Wednesday's practice with a calf issue, but he was able to participate in a limited fashion on Thursday and will have a chance to play in Week 7. The team won't make an official determination about his status until closer to game time, however.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Andrew Thomas (groin) officially limited Thursday
items.desc: Andrew Thomas (groin) was officially a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Thomas was able to practice in a limited fashion on Thursday after being absent from Wednesday's practice due to a groin issue. He will likely be available for Week 7, which is good news for New York's offense this week.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Christian Gonzalez (illness) good to for Thursday
items.desc: Christian Gonzalez is active for the Patriots Thursday night game against the Bears after being labeled questionable an hour before inactives were released due to an illness.
items.impact: The sickness must have come on fairly quickly, as the star corner was only labeled questionable an hour ago. But, he is good to go and will play. He will give Rome Odunze, Kalif Raymond, and whoever Chicago sends outside fits.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: T.J. Edwards (hamstring) out on Thursday against Patriots
items.desc: T.J. Edwards (hamstring) is out for the Bears game against the Patriots on Thursday.
items.impact: Edwards was originally doubtful heading into this contest, and will now miss his second straight game. Noah Sewell should be next in line for snaps.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Puka Nacua leaves practice early on Thursday due to calf injury
items.desc: Puka Nacua left practice early on Thursday due to a calf injury.
items.impact: The already injury riddled Rams might have another one to deal with, this time their superstar wideout. With Davante Adams already out, and Terrance Ferguson not ready to return, the team is running short of capable pass catchers. If Puka misses time expect Tyler Higbee and Kyren Williams to see additional work.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Brevin Jordan (foot) limited at practice Thursday
items.desc: Brevin Jordan (foot) was a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Jordan is a new addition to Houston's injury report, being listed with a foot issue that left him limited on Thursday. He seems to be trending the wrong way for Week 7, but his potential absence wouldn't have a big impact for fantasy purposes.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: David Montgomery (groin) officially a non-participant Thursday
items.desc: David Montgomery (groin) was officially a non-participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: As expected, Montgomery wasn't able to take part in Houston's practice on Thursday. He's not expected to play again in Week 7, which would likely leave Woody Marks and Jawhar Jordan as the team's primary running backs against the Giants this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Trent Brown (wrist) upgraded to full participant Thursday
items.desc: Trent Brown (wrist) was upgraded to a full participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: The Texans held Brown out of Wednesday's practice due to a wrist issue that he was dealing with, but he was upgraded to a full participant on Thursday. He should be good to go for Week 7, which is good news for Houston's offense.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Dalton Schultz (quad) returns to practice Thursday
items.desc: Dalton Schultz (quad) returned to practice as a limited participant on Thursday.
items.impact: Schultz was back at practice on Thursday after missing Wednesday's practice due to a quad issue. It looks like he will play in Week 7, assuming he doesn't suffer any setbacks at practice throughout the rest of the week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Azeez Al-Shaair (groin) officially limited Thursday
items.desc: Azeez Al-Shaair (groin) was officially a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Al-Shaair made his return to practice on Thursday and was officially a limited participant. It looks like he's gearing up to play in Week 7, but we won't know for sure until later on in the week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Keenan Allen (rest) returns to practice Thursday
items.desc: Keenan Allen (rest) returned to practice as a full participant on Thursday.
items.impact: As expected, Allen was back at practice on Thursday after getting the day off on Wednesday. He was a full participant and should be fully good to go for Week 7's matchup against the Minnesota Vikings.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Anthony Gould (concussion) absent from practice Thursday
items.desc: Anthony Gould (concussion) was absent from another practice session on Thursday.
items.impact: Gould is still in the NFL's concussion protocols and wasn't able to practice again on Thursday as a result. He is likely to be out in Week 7, but his absence wouldn't have much of an impact for fantasy purposes.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Ashton Dulin (hamstring) considered limited Thursday
items.desc: Ashton Dulin (hamstring) was considered a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Dulin was only able to participate in Thursday's practice in a limited fashion, thanks to the hamstring injury he's dealing with. He may play in Week 7, but fantasy managers shouldn't expect him to do much even if active against the Vikings.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Kene Nwangwu (knee) absent from practice Thursday
items.desc: Kene Nwangwu (knee) was absent from New York's practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Nwangwu was again not at practice on Thursday as he continues to battle a knee injury. He will likely be out in Week 7, which will have much more of an impact on New York's special-teams unit rather than their offense.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Breece Hall (quad) returns to practice Thursday
items.desc: Breece Hall (quad) returned to practice as a limited participant on Thursday.
items.impact: Hall was a non-participant on Wednesday to start the week, but he made his return to practice on Thursday and will have a real chance to play in Week 7. Fantasy managers should keep close tabs on updates about his health heading into the weekend to see if he will play and have any limitations against the Dolphins on Sunday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Joseph Ossai (ankle) misses another practice Thursday
items.desc: Joseph Ossai (ankle) missed another practice session on Thursday.
items.impact: Ossai was unable to practice again on Thursday, which makes it seem unlikely that he will suit up in Week 7. New York's defensive front will continue to be shorthanded for however long he remains out of the lineup.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Dylan Parham (knee) limited Thursday
items.desc: Dylan Parham (knee) was limited at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Parham was limited for another practice on Thursday. It seems he is drawing closer and closer to full health, which means he may be back in the lineup as soon as Week 7, which would be good news for New York's offense as a whole.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Adonai Mitchell (finger) listed as limited Thursday
items.desc: Adonai Mitchell (finger) was listed as a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Mitchell was again a limited participant at practice on Thursday, as he's still working his way back from a finger injury that has left him sidelined for multiple weeks. It looks like he's trending towards playing in Week 7, but we likely won't know his official status until after practice on Friday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: AJ Dillon (ankle) full participant Thursday
items.desc: AJ Dillon (ankle) was a full participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: The veteran was a full participant at Thursday's practice, just as he was on Wednesday as well. He should be available to suit up in Week 7 but isn't likely to see much playing time in Carolina's backfield in a divisional matchup against the Buccaneers this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Chuba Hubbard (rest) returns to full practice Thursday
items.desc: Chuba Hubbard (rest) returned to practice in a full capacity on Thursday.
items.impact: Hubbard was given the day off on Wednesday as a veteran rest day, but he returned to practice on Thursday and was a full participant. He should be good to go for Week 7 and remains a must-start fantasy option for the foreseeable future.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Sean Tucker (quad) practices in full Thursday
items.desc: Sean Tucker (quad) practiced in a full capacity on Thursday.
items.impact: Tucker was able to practice in a full capacity for a second-straight practice on Thursday, putting him squarely on track to play in Week 7. If he makes his return on Sunday, get some opportunities against the Panthers but isn't likely to be fantasy relevant in that game.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Antoine Winfield Jr. (rib) limited Thursday
items.desc: Antoine Winfield Jr. (rib) was limited at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Winfield was practicing in a red non-contact jersey on Thursday and was officially a limited participant. It remains to be seen whether or not he's available to suit up and play in Week 7.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Baker Mayfield (thumb) logs another full practice Thursday
items.desc: Baker Mayfield (thumb) logged another full practice session on Thursday.
items.impact: As expected, Mayfield was again a full participant at practice on Thursday and seems to be strongly trending towards playing in Week 7. Look for Emeka Egbuka (concussion/foot) and Bucky Irving (illness) to be two of the primary beneficiaries of his return if he's cleared to play this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Bucky Irving (illness) back at practice Thursday
items.desc: Bucky Irving (illness) was back at practice as a limited participant on Thursday.
items.impact: Irving is currently recovering from an illness of some kind and missed Wednesday's practice as a result, but he was back at practice on Thursday and participated in a limited capacity. That's a good sign that he will be fully good to go for Sunday's game against the Panthers.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Emeka Egbuka (concussion/foot) misses practice Thursday
items.desc: Emeka Egbuka (concussion/foot) missed another practice session on Thursday.
items.impact: Egbuka was again unable to practice on Thursday. He was seen working off to the side with a trainer, but unless he's able to return to team drills on Friday, it looks like he's going to be sidelined in Week 7. If that's the case, that would lead to more work for rookie Ted Hurst III against the Panthers.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: CJ Donaldson (shoulder) upgraded to full participant Thursday
items.desc: CJ Donaldson (shoulder) was upgraded to a full participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Donaldson was limited at Wednesday's practice due to a shoulder issue, but he is already over it and was able to practice in full on Thursday. He should play without limitations in Week 7 but may not have much fantasy value while sharing the backfield with Alvin Kamara and Kendre Miller against a tough Steelers defense.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Alvin Kamara (back) limited participant Thursday
items.desc: Alvin Kamara (back) was a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: To no surprise, Kamara was left limited for another practice on Thursday due to the back injury that he's managing. He should play in Week 7, but it remains unlikely that he will have a strong performance from a fantasy perspective.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Ben Skowronek (calf) won't play Week 7
items.desc: Ben Skowronek (calf) won't play in Week 7's matchup against the New Orleans Saints.
items.impact: The veteran wideout is going to miss another game due to the calf issue that he's recovering from. Rookie Germie Bernard was already expected to see a lot of work in this game, but this move clears his path to a large workload even more.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jalen Ramsey (wrist) returns to practice Thursday
items.desc: Jalen Ramsey (wrist) returned to Pittsburgh's practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Ramsey was back at practice as a limited participant on Thursday, which was expected. He should be available to play in Week 7 and will continue to be one of the key members of a strong Pittsburgh defense moving forward.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: DeShon Elliott (knee) logs full practice Thursday
items.desc: DeShon Elliott (knee) logged a full practice session on Thursday.
items.impact: Elliot was able to log another full practice session on Thursday, which bodes well for his availability for Week 7. We should know more about his official status after tomorrow's practice.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Rico Dowdle (knee) limited again Thursday
items.desc: Rico Dowdle (knee) was limited at practice again on Thursday.
items.impact: The veteran running back was limited for another practice session on Thursday as he continues to manage a knee injury of some kind. He was able to play through it last week, however, so the expectation is that he will do the same again in Week 7.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Teven Jenkins (back) not practicing Thursday
items.desc: Teven Jenkins is not practicing on Thursday.
items.impact: Jenkins will likely need to practice in some capacity on Friday to have a chance to play in Sunday's game against the Browns.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kalia Davis (quad) not practicing Thursday
items.desc: Kalia Davis is not practicing on Thursday.
items.impact: Davis appears on track to be missing another game on Sunday against the Titans.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Mike Hall Jr. (ankle) not practicing Thursday
items.desc: Mike Hall Jr. remained absent from practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Hall will likely have to practice in some capacity on Friday to have a chance to play on Sunday against the Titans.
